hypothesis: The exact hash-bound EXP31 validity filter and source lineage, followed by the hash-bound EXP33-qualified V5 execution engine, can process the frozen opaque N009/N010 physical pair within 180 seconds and 4 GiB per source child and produce a deterministic source-only CAD-deviation result or preregistered abstention without evaluator information.

qualified_v5_source_free_call_surface_li.reason: Its execute_source_v5 entry point invokes filter_source_rows_v5; EXP34 must invoke the exact frozen EXP31 filter once instead.

immutable_source_lineage.path_and_hash_binding_rule: Every resolved source, transform, CAD, code, preregistration, result, approval, lock, and renderer path must equal its fresh EXP34 lock entry; an alternate path is rejected even if bytes match.
immutable_source_lineage.scan_access_rule: The expected scan hashes are constants only until the authorized source child checkpoints its durable journal and performs the corresponding hash operation. No preflight, audit, approval, or lock builder may open or hash either scan.
authorized_scan_operation_order_per_sour: atomically checkpoint N009 hash attempt, hash N009, and require observed SHA-256 equals the N009 expected constant
atomically checkpoint N010 hash attempt, hash N010, and require observed SHA-256 equals the N010 expected constant
only after both hashes match, atomically checkpoint N009 point-cloud load attempt and load N009 exactly once
atomically checkpoint N010 point-cloud load attempt and load N010 exactly once

physical_loader_and_transform_contract.loader: Call open3d.io.read_point_cloud on each exact lock-bound path with format='auto', remove_nan_points=false, remove_infinite_points=false, and print_progress=false under the exact attested Open3D 0.19.0 environment.
physical_loader_and_transform_contract.numeric_materialization: Immediately materialize points and normals separately as C-contiguous NumPy float64 Nx3 arrays while preserving returned PLY acquisition order.
physical_loader_and_transform_contract.raw_row_count_gate: N009 points and normals must each contain exactly 1156302 rows; N010 points and normals must each contain exactly 1323486 rows. These are authenticated source-lineage point counts, not evaluator expected bend counts.
physical_loader_and_transform_contract.shape_and_normal_gate: Each point array must be Nx3; its normal array must have the identical shape; missing or mismatched normals are terminal and may not be estimated or repaired.
physical_loader_and_transform_contract.transform_linkage: For each opaque token, require the exact semantic-file SHA-256, experiment_id EXP_CAD_0015, matching case_token, matching inherited scan_sha256, matching raw_scan_point_count, alignment_abstained=false, evaluator_data_opened=false, and gold_or_expected_counts_used=false before extracting the matrix.
physical_loader_and_transform_contract.transform_geometry: Require one finite float64 4x4 matrix, exact homogeneous bottom row [0,0,0,1], R^T R equal to identity within atol 1e-8 and rtol 0, and determinant +1 within atol 1e-8 and rtol 0.

immutable_cad_artifacts.load_and_validation_order: After the fresh EXP34 approval and lock verify, validate both transform files and load and validate every CAD artifact before the first physical scan hash attempt.

exact_source_interface_contract.implementation: Call scripts.exp_cad_0031_source_interface.filter_source_rows exactly once for each loaded member, then call scripts.exp_cad_0031_source_interface.pair_actionability exactly once after both reports exist; the optimized V5 filter implementation may not replace or precede these physical intake calls.
exact_source_interface_contract.application_order: After exact Nx3 and equal point/normal row-count validation and before rigid transform, normal canonicalization, partition, voxelization, local fitting, or any V5 parent-science operation.
exact_source_interface_contract.original_row_identity: Assign uint64 acquisition ordinal 0..N-1 before filtering and carry it through the exact EXP31 report contract.
exact_source_interface_contract.retained_order: Exact acquisition order; no sorting, duplication, replacement, interpolation, normal estimation, or neighbor borrowing.
exact_source_interface_contract.rejected_identity_use: Audit reporting only; row locations and identities are forbidden scientific or quality features.

scientific_execution_contract.actionable_input: Only exact EXP31-retained point and normal arrays, in acquisition order, enter the frozen transforms and V5 parent-science call.
scientific_execution_contract.frozen_parent_semantics: Exact EXP30 scientific preregistration and payload semantics under the source-free-qualified V5 execution replacements.
scientific_execution_contract.nonfinite_publication_policy: Use the frozen parent recursive JSON conversion in which every NaN and positive or negative infinity becomes JSON null before strict canonical JSON encoding.

source_interface_abstention.condition: Either member fails the exact EXP31 actionability gate.
source_interface_abstention.legacy_nested_status_interpretation: The EXP31 NO_RERUN token is retained verbatim as nested interface identity. The conditional fresh-process EXP34 replay is an EXP34 determinism obligation, not a rerun or rescue of EXP31.

scientific_result_or_abstention.status_source: Exact nested frozen EXP30 semantic payload returned by the qualified V5 engine.

execution_failure.conditions: Any hash, binding, load, validation, process, timeout, RSS, publication, counter, renderer, replay, byte-equality, or native-review failure.

one_shot_physical_execution.resource_limit_inclusivity: A child passes only when measured wall time is <= its wall cap and measured peak process-tree RSS is <= 4294967296 bytes.
one_shot_physical_execution.primary_success_definition: The primary source child exits zero and atomically publishes a complete preregistered interface abstention or complete scientific result/abstention. On the scientific path the primary renderer must also complete successfully before replay begins.
one_shot_physical_execution.interface_abstention_branch: After a successful primary interface abstention, run exactly one fresh replay source child, require byte-exact deterministic source artifacts, run zero renderer children, then publish the terminal source-interface abstention.
one_shot_physical_execution.scientific_branch: After successful primary source and primary renderer completion, run exactly one fresh replay source child and replay renderer, then require byte-exact source scientific trees and byte-exact renderer trees.
one_shot_physical_execution.primary_failure_branch: On any primary source or required primary renderer failure, run zero replay source children and zero replay renderer children, publish FAIL_TERMINAL_NO_RETRY outside all child roots, and stop.
one_shot_physical_execution.replay_failure_branch: On replay source, replay renderer, or equality failure, publish FAIL_TERMINAL_NO_RETRY and stop.

durable_scan_access_accounting.journal_location: Each source child receives a distinct SOURCE_SCAN_ACCOUNTING_JOURNAL.json path beneath the lock-authorized non-compared measurement root, outside its deterministic source tree.
durable_scan_access_accounting.checkpoint_rule: Atomically checkpoint the journal before each attempted physical scan SHA-256 operation and before each attempted physical point-cloud load operation.
durable_scan_access_accounting.attempt_semantics: Counters include an attempted operation even if the child later crashes, times out, exceeds RSS, or fails to persist another artifact.
durable_scan_access_accounting.terminal_aggregation_precedence: The orchestrator must prefer each durable journal over child result or failure metadata whenever the journal exists.

determinism_and_tree_contract.primary_and_replay_output_roots: Fresh, disjoint, absent-or-empty roots fixed by the immutable EXP34 execution lock.
determinism_and_tree_contract.terminal_result_root: Outside both compared trees and fixed by the immutable EXP34 execution lock.
determinism_and_tree_contract.source_tree_exactness: On the interface-abstention branch, exact EXP31 interface reports, pair gate, retained-identity hashes, and EXP34 zero engine-invocation accounting must be byte-identical between primary and replay and no EXP32 metrics payload may exist. On the science branch, those interface artifacts plus the nested EXP30 semantic payload, nested EXP30 visual payload, and a clearly labelled deterministic projection of the exact EXP32 operation counters must be byte-identical.
determinism_and_tree_contract.renderer_tree_exactness: When a visual payload exists, every renderer-produced file and its complete relative-path SHA-256 map must be byte-identical between primary and replay.
determinism_and_tree_contract.excluded_from_compared_trees: Wall/RSS telemetry, stdout, stderr, durable scan accounting journals, launch claims, and orchestration metadata must be stored outside the deterministic comparison roots or in explicitly non-compared measurement roots.
determinism_and_tree_contract.canonical_json: UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii false, allow_nan false, and atomic replace.
determinism_and_tree_contract.equality_failure_policy: Terminal failure; no third child, rerun, normalization rescue, or manual waiver.

honest_nested_identity_contract.source_interface_reports: Retain EXP_CAD_0031_SOURCE_INTERFACE_REPORT_V1 identity and bytes; do not relabel them as EXP34.
honest_nested_identity_contract.scientific_semantic_payload: Retain the exact frozen EXP30 schema, experiment_id, architecture, and canonical bytes returned by the qualified V5 execution context.
honest_nested_identity_contract.scientific_visual_payload: Retain the exact frozen EXP30 visual schema and canonical bytes; the exact EXP30 renderer consumes it.
honest_nested_identity_contract.v5_engine_metrics: Only on the science branch, persist the complete returned EXP32 engine-metrics object verbatim under the non-compared measurement root, retaining its schema, experiment_id, architecture, and elapsed runtime. Publish only a clearly labelled deterministic counter projection inside the compared source tree. On the interface-abstention branch, publish the frozen EXP34 zero engine-invocation accounting and no EXP32 metrics object.
honest_nested_identity_contract.exp33_qualification_artifacts: Referenced by exact path and SHA-256; never copied into or relabelled as physical evidence.

native_visual_review_contract.renderer: The exact hash-bound EXP30 renderer executes in fresh child processes under the frozen caps.
native_visual_review_contract.native_resolution: Review every renderer-declared native asset at its exact pixel dimensions without downsampling, resynthesis, or replacement.
native_visual_review_contract.review_inputs: Only source semantic payloads, renderer manifests, native assets, exact pixel dimensions, and SHA-256 maps; evaluator roles, labels, gold, expected counts, and quality identities remain unavailable.
required_checks: all declared native assets exist and their hashes and dimensions match the renderer manifest
primary and replay renderer trees are byte-identical
assets are nonblank, nontruncated, and internally consistent with the numeric source payload
component, attribution, abstention, and legend annotations do not contradict the nested source semantics

required_source_free_test_inventory: mocked canonical scan order checkpoints each journal before N009 hash, N010 hash, N009 load, and N010 load
either observed scan-hash mismatch is terminal before either load call
synthetic PLY loader fixture preserves row order, nonfinite rows, and supplied normals with no parser-side removal or estimation
transform validation accepts only raw_scan_to_reference_transform with exact schema, token, scan hash, row count, proper-rigid geometry, and sealed-input flags
exact EXP31 filter is called once per member and exact pair_actionability is called once; V5 filter and source-free execute_source_v5 are never called
interface-abstention branch invokes the V5 engine zero times, runs one conditional replay, runs zero renderers, and publishes byte-exact EXP34 zero accounting
science branch invokes execute_parent_science_v5 exactly once per source child, runs one primary and one replay renderer, and preserves exact nested EXP30 and EXP32 identities
any primary source or primary renderer failure launches zero replay source and replay renderer children
replay, publication, equality, native-review, timeout, or RSS failure is terminal with no retry or third child
resolved-path binding rejects alternate same-hash files, symlinks, parent traversal, aliases, ancestor overlaps, and outputs outside the authorized namespace
external process-tree monitor kills source children above 180 seconds or 4 GiB and renderer children above 60 seconds or 4 GiB while preserving journal and launch accounting
strict canonical publication converts all nonfinite floats to JSON null and rejects any remaining nonfinite JSON token
deterministic source and renderer tree maps pass exact equality and a one-byte mutation is detected as terminal
atomic create-if-absent launch claim prevents a second orchestration even after crash or timeout
all tests and audits report zero physical scan hash, load, and byte-open operations and zero evaluator, role, label, gold, quality, or expected-bend-count access
required_regression_suites: new lock-bound EXP34 loader, source, monitor, and orchestration tests
fresh_exp34_approval_and_lock_contract.test_attestation_contract: Persist exact command, collected test identifiers, passed/failed/skipped counts, exit status, all test-file hashes, and zero scan/evaluator access counters; bind the attestation into the prelock approval and immutable lock.
fresh_exp34_approval_and_lock_contract.fresh_environment_attestation_contract: Before lock materialization, attest the resolved Python executable path, realpath, executable SHA-256, Python version, NumPy version and origin, SciPy version and origin, and Open3D version and origin; each must exactly match the hash-bound EXP33 environment attestation. Any mismatch blocks physical authorization rather than creating a runtime exception.
fresh_exp34_approval_and_lock_contract.lock_materialization_timing: After the EXP34 runner, orchestrator, monitor, tests, and independent source-free audit are complete, and strictly before the sole physical orchestration invocation.
lock_must_bind_by_repo_relative_path_siz: all EXP30, EXP31, EXP32, and EXP33 lineage artifacts named above
the exact EXP31 filter, qualified V5 engine, lineage-only V5 call surface, frozen parent core, science and runner, and exact renderer
the authenticated source manifest and fresh EXP34 environment attestation
all CAD and transform artifacts named above
the new EXP34 runner, orchestrator, monitor, tests, audit packet, and prelock readiness approval
fresh_exp34_approval_and_lock_contract.launch_claim_contract: After exact lock and detached approval verification and before spawning any source or renderer child, atomically create the canonical launch claim with create-if-absent/no-overwrite semantics, fsync it and its parent directory, and record the preregistration SHA-256, lock SHA-256, detached approval SHA-256, exact resolved inputs, exact output paths, and invocation ordinal 1. Any existing claim blocks execution permanently; it may not be deleted, overwritten, or bypassed after crash, timeout, or failure.
fresh_exp34_approval_and_lock_contract.output_path_gates: Every output path must be repo-relative; all attempt artifacts except the global terminal result must strictly resolve beneath the lock-authorized result namespace; roots must be mutually disjoint with no ancestor overlap across compared and non-compared roots; output files must be absent and output roots absent or empty before the launch claim. Future outputs are path-authorized, not assigned impossible pre-execution size or content hashes.
fresh_exp34_approval_and_lock_contract.scan_lock_binding: Bind each exact resolved scan path and inherited expected SHA-256 constant without opening or hashing the scan during lock construction.
fresh_exp34_approval_and_lock_contract.confused_deputy_rejection: Every static CLI path must equal its lock row after strict resolution; reject alternate same-hash paths, symlinks, parent traversal, path aliases, and outputs outside locked roots.
fresh_exp34_approval_and_lock_contract.detached_postlock_approval_timing: Materialize only after the immutable lock exists; it must bind the exact lock path and SHA-256 and therefore is intentionally not hash-bound inside that lock.
fresh_exp34_approval_and_lock_contract.detached_postlock_approval_path_binding: The lock fixes docs/research/2026-08-30_exp_cad_0034_detached_postlock_physical_execution_approval.json but not its bytes; the exact detached approval SHA-256 is supplied separately to the sole orchestrator invocation and atomically recorded in the pre-spawn launch claim.

evidence_boundary.interpretation: A pass establishes bounded deterministic physical source execution for this one frozen opaque pair only. It does not reveal correctness, quality role, unseen-family performance, bend-line F1, or production readiness.

terminal_policy.failure_successor_policy: Any later work must use a new experiment identity and a newly preregistered scientific or systems hypothesis; EXP34 itself cannot be rerun.
